cluster_recommendation: The core research cluster (ceramic-search → perplexity-research → web-researcher → deep-research) is conceptually sound and consistently cross-referenced in the right priority order across all four files, but web-researcher carries the batch's worst rot: a stale claim that gemini-url-context is broken (it isn't — it was rewritten onto the agentbox-mcp Rust binary months ago and is live), a description that busts the 1024-char cap, and a version number that only its own file gets right (SKILL-DIRECTORY.md and agentbox.toml both cite older, wrong versions). Fix web-researcher first — its 'gemini-url-context is dead' line actively steers agents (and other skills' authors) away from a working tool. Second priority: close the routing-table.md gap for ceramic-search, deep-research, autoresearch and email-search (web-researcher is already known-missing per the fact sheet) so the dispatcher actually knows about the estate's primary search engine and its own orchestrator. Third: the AEO/GEO duplication between bencium-aeo and toprank's nested geo-content-optimizer needs a single owner — right now the boundary is thin, one-directional, and both bodies teach the same 18-token/citation/freshness techniques independently. Fourth: linkedin's private Patchright Chromium is a direct, self-inflicted violation of the sidecar-only browser policy that web-researcher itself enforces two directories over — and together with reddit and notebooklm it has zero agentbox.toml manifest gate, leaving three MCP servers (one with a self-disclosed ToS risk) permanently on with no kill switch. Everything else in the batch — perplexity-research, ceramic-search, notebooklm, autoresearch, and email-search bar one internal contradiction about which REASONER_BASE_URL is correct — is in good shape and matches the live-infrastructure fact sheet closely; email-search in particular is the best-maintained skill in the batch and should be the template for how the others reference the Loom façade.
unverifiable: Live reachability of api.ceramic.ai, api.perplexity.ai, LinkedIn/Reddit OAuth endpoints, and the NotebookLM SDK were not probed — no network egress check was performed, only static/file evidence.
